sections.name: body
sections.value: Dropped 2026-11-08 07:30 by the prime's ruling, relayed by pm-001: both seats that hit Copilot's follow-up dialog (herring and squirrel, security, gpt-6.1-sol) now run copilot --resume ... --no-ask-user (the F110 flag, checked in their process argv). The notes 'Re-granted: PA may ctrl+d Copilot's follow-up dialog (until F109)' and the earlier F108 one no longer apply. Back to role.md: never type into a pane. If a modal-stall tell still arrives, capture the pane and report it in one line to the prime and pm-001: either a seat isn't on the flag, or the flag didn't hold.
